DELETE FROM EDS.BOB_TRANHIST WHERE AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) FROM D360.STG_EDS_BOB_TRANHIST);

INSERT INTO EDS.BOB_TRANHIST
(
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,AMOUNT
    ,BRANCH
    ,CHANNEL
    ,CHECK_NUMBER
    ,CREDIT_AMOUNT
    ,CURRENCY
    ,DEBIT_AMOUNT
    ,ID
    ,MODE_OF_PLACEMENT
    ,PLACEMENT_STATUS
    ,REFERENCE_NUMBER
    ,RUNNING_BALANCE
    ,TRANSACTION_DATE
    ,TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION
    ,TRANSACTION_TYPE
    ,VALUE_DATE
    ,isActive
    ,isLatest
    ,BNK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,AMOUNT
    ,BRANCH
    ,CHANNEL
    ,CHECK_NUMBER
    ,CREDIT_AMOUNT
    ,CURRENCY
    ,DEBIT_AMOUNT
    ,ID
    ,MODE_OF_PLACEMENT
    ,PLACEMENT_STATUS
    ,REFERENCE_NUMBER
    ,RUNNING_BALANCE
    ,TRANSACTION_DATE
    ,TRANSACTION_DESCRIPTION
    ,TRANSACTION_TYPE
    ,VALUE_DATE
    ,1 as isActive
    ,1 as isLatest
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_BOB_TRANHIST
WHERE H = 'D'
